fusions.name: Silver Shunt
fusions.desc: Slams a scaled shoulder into the target, dealing 12 damage, knocking it back 2.5 tiles and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Scale Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks overlapping plates at every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip the Net
fusions.desc: Curls you into a slick ball for 6 seconds: you move 10% faster, enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Shed and Scatter
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you gain a shield worth 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds and +8% dodge chance. Once every 60 seconds.
